subject.title: Reject split outbound agent session ownership

question: Should OpenClaw reject every explicit-agent and agent-scoped-session ownership mismatch at Gateway and lower outbound boundaries, rather than preserve explicit-agent precedence for existing callers?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility break across an externally reachable Gateway contract and internal outbound APIs; source-level correctness cannot determine the desired upgrade posture.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed ownership
options.body: Accept the branch’s invariant after refreshed current-head proof shows both Gateway routes and the allowed compatibility cases.

options.title: Preserve precedence by default
options.body: Keep existing explicit-agent precedence and design an explicit opt-in strict mode or migration path if split-owner rejection is still desired.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Reject only at selected public boundaries while documenting the remaining internal ownership contract and its rationale.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed ownership
recommendation.body: Accept the branch’s invariant after refreshed current-head proof shows both Gateway routes and the allowed compatibility cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically routes the outbound/Gateway contract question to this reviewer.
